chip.$description: Chip component tokens: removable selected values (a chosen state, metro or filter). Measured from the audit's captured CSS of the 'Colorado x' chip inside the expanded filters panel's States field (class 'ui-select-match-item', audit F14, 12 instances). Decision 25.

height.$description: OBSERVED: 25px; became 24px (4px grid), still the minimum target for its remove button (WCAG 2.5.8).

gap.$description: PROPOSED: between label and remove button.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: 3px; became 4px. Chips live inside fields, so they take the field radius (decision 25).

background.$description: OBSERVED: light blue #eef7ff fill. Chips use the primitive tint through this component token; there's no semantic token for it because nothing else uses it yet.

border.$description: OBSERVED: light blue rgba(151,201,255,.4) border, kept (composited to #cbe5ff). Decorative: the text and the remove button identify the chip, so it needs no 3:1.

text.$description: OBSERVED: #000000; became ink, 15.73:1 on the tint.

size.$description: PROPOSED: the remove button's target, the 24px minimum (WCAG 2.5.8).

background-hover.$description: PROPOSED: hover on the remove button. Not observed.

color.$description: PROPOSED: the system focus ring, on the focused chip.
